description: This file defines the ShellViewFeatureProvider class, which implements application feature provider interfaces for managing view features in an OrchardCore MVC application. It handles populating view descriptors from modules and manages feature registration based on environment and module references.

classes.name: ShellViewFeatureProvider
classes.description: Implements application feature providers to manage view descriptors for OrchardCore MVC modules, supporting both production and development environments.

methods.name: ShellViewFeatureProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes environment and application context services.

methods.name: PopulateFeature
methods.description: Populates view features for the application, considering environment and scope.

methods.name: PopulateFeature
methods.description: Overloaded method to populate development view features, with special handling for dev mode and refs folder.

methods.name: PopulateFeatureInternal
methods.description: Internal method to gather view descriptors from modules and assemblies, considering project references and precompiled views.

methods.name: EnsureScopedServices
methods.description: Ensures that scoped services are initialized and cached for feature population.
